business.what_it_does: Makes and sells textile products measured in pieces (61.9 million in Q1 FY27) through a distributor network that is being moved onto a distributor management system (DMS); key inputs are cotton, nylon, fabrics and petroleum-based synthetics. The inputs do not name brands, product categories or segments.

segments.name: Single reported business (no split in inputs)
segments.comment: Q1 FY27 revenue INR 14,204 million (+7.9% YoY), volume +5.7%, EBITDA margin 20.3% (C1); TTM revenue INR 5,500 crore.

credibility.label: medium
credibility.summary: Reliable on the variable it controls: the 19-21% EBITDA margin band has been restated on four calls, H1 FY27 printed 20.6%, and the Q3 FY26 warning that ~22% margins would not last proved right. Growth promises are restated rather than met: double-digit volume is still the FY27 goal after Q1 volume grew 5.7%, and revenue has compounded 3.6% a year over three years.

promises.evidence: Check: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 20.6% (Q1 20.4%, Q2 20.8%), inside 19-21%. Margin is down YoY (Q2 20.8% vs 21.7%; Q1 20.3% vs 22.4% per C1) after cotton and nylon inflation, which management says had largely normalised by end-June (C3).

Q1 FY27 volume grew 5.7% (C1). Assuming similar-sized quarters, the remaining three need ~11.4% on average to reach 10% for the year. Q2 volume is not in the inputs; Q2 revenue grew 11.5% but included Q1 billing shifted into Q2 (G3).

Q2 FY27 revenue growth rose to 11.5% from 7.8% in Q1, consistent with deferred billing landing in Q2, but the size of the Q1 shortfall was never quantified, so 'majority' cannot be tested. The two quarters average ~9.7%, so the shift moved revenue between quarters rather than adding to H1.
promises.actual: Q2 FY27 revenue +11.5% YoY vs Q1 +7.8%

promises.evidence: As of the Q1 FY27 call only 'a very small portion' of distributors were on DMS (C4). The deadline is end-FY27 with Q1 FY28 as fallback, and management adds another quarter to stabilise before efficiencies show.
Check: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 20.6%, inside the band; the same range was restated in Q1 FY27 (G1).
Restated in Q1 FY27 (G2). Q1 FY27 volume +5.7% (C1) against a 10% floor; the rest of the year needs ~11.4% on average.
FY27 has not ended and no subsidy receipts are reported in the inputs. INR 40-50 crore equals ~0.7-0.9% of TTM revenue (INR 5,500 crore), so where it is booked matters for the margin band.
The ledger notes the referent of 'close to 5%' is unclear from the passage; nothing in the inputs can be matched to it.
Check: H1 FY27 EBITDA margin 20.6%. The range has been held unchanged on every call since (G5, G1) and is also framed as a long-term range.
Margin stepped down from 22.9% in Q3 FY26 to 20.8%, 20.4% and 20.8% in the next three quarters, as warned; the Q1 FY27 call attributed the decline to cotton, nylon and synthetics inflation (C3).

No timeline. Revenue growth over the last four quarters was 5.6%, 14.1%, 7.8% and 11.5%: two of four in double digits, average ~9.8%. Q2's 11.5% was helped by billing moved from Q1 (G3). 3-year revenue CAGR is 3.6%.
'Near double-digit' with no date: the last four quarters averaged ~9.8% (5.6%, 14.1%, 7.8%, 11.5%), which meets 'near', though it follows a 3-year revenue CAGR of only 3.6%.
Unspecified horizon. Q4 FY26 to Q2 FY27 margins of 20.8%, 20.4% and 20.8% are inside the band; Q3 FY26 was above it at 22.9% and TTM is 21.2%.
No FY26 capex figure is in the inputs.
No marketing spend figure is in the inputs.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: EBITDA margin will stay within 19-21% for FY27 despite input-cost inflation (C3, G1).
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: H1 FY27 margin 20.6% (Q1 20.4%, Q2 20.8%), inside the band, though Q2 is down 90 bps YoY from 21.7%.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: 'The annual goal remains unchanged... double-digit growth in volume' (G2), with revenue also targeted back at double digits (G11).
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Q1 FY27 volume +5.7% and revenue +7.8%; Q2 revenue +11.5% was partly Q1 billing moved into Q2 (G3). 3-year revenue CAGR is 3.6% vs 13.1% over five years.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Input costs had largely normalised by end-June and are expected to stay stable (C3).
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Q2 FY27 margin recovered only 40 bps QoQ to 20.8%, and PAT grew 4.1% YoY on revenue +11.5%, so profit is lagging sales while margin stays below last year's 21.7%.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Working capital tightening: inventory days 73 to 66 and net working capital days 56 to 54 in Q1 FY27 (C1).
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Consistent with the longer trend: cash conversion cycle 138 days vs 240 three years ago, 5-year CFO/PAT 1.07, ROCE 64%.

bull.point: Margin guidance is dependable: 19-21% restated on four calls (G13, G9, G5, G1), H1 FY27 at 20.6%, and the Q3 FY26 call correctly warned that ~22% would not last (G10).
Capital efficiency: ROCE 64%, 5-year CFO/PAT 1.07, cash conversion cycle cut from 240 to 138 days over three years; borrowings only INR 396 crore (debt/equity 0.26).

Growth is picking up from a low base: revenue +14.1% and +11.5% in two of the last four quarters vs a 3-year CAGR of 3.6%, and the full DMS rollout due by end-FY27 / Q1 FY28 is aimed at distribution efficiencies (C4, G4).

bear.point: Volume goal already behind: Q1 FY27 volume +5.7% vs a double-digit FY27 target (G2, G6), so the remaining quarters need ~11.4%, and Q2's 11.5% revenue growth was flattered by Q1 billing shifted into Q2 (G3).

Margin upside capped by management's own band: TTM margin 21.2% is at the 21% ceiling (G1) and management said ~22% was not sustainable (G10), so PAT growth must come from revenue; Q2 PAT grew only 4.1% on 11.5% revenue growth.

Growth promises are repeated, not delivered: 'near double-digit' (Q2 FY26, G12) and 'double-digit' (Q3 FY26, G11) aspirations carry no date, while 3-year revenue CAGR is 3.6% and 3-year PAT CAGR of 10.2% came largely from +370 bps of margin.

questions: What was Q2 FY27 volume growth, and how much of Q2's 11.5% revenue growth was Q1 billing shifted into Q2 (G3)? In other words, what is underlying H1 growth against the double-digit volume goal (G2)?
Where will the INR 40-50 crore FY27 subsidy (G7) be booked? If it sits inside EBITDA it is worth ~70-90 bps of margin, so what is the 19-21% band excluding it?
What did the Q4 FY26 'close to 5%' target (G8) refer to (marketing spend vs the 4-4.5% FY26 budget in G15, or something else), and how much H1 FY27 spend went toward it?
